label: Admissions
seo_description: Inquiry through enrollment with pipelines, documents, interviews, and audit-ready decisions.
headline: Turn every inquiry into an organized enrollment journey.
subheadline: Manage inquiries, applications, document collection, review stages, admission decisions, enrollment conversion, family communication, and first invoice handoff—so the front office and the rest of the school stay in sync.

segments.title: Pipeline clarity
segments.body: Stages, owners, SLAs, and document checklists everyone can trust.

segments.title: Family experience
segments.body: Applicants submit once; status and next steps stay visible in the portal.

segments.title: Leadership oversight
segments.body: Conversion signals across campuses without spreadsheet rollups.

problem_section.title: Pipeline blind spots slow enrollment
problem_section.body: Without a connected admissions workflow, inquiries stall, documents scatter, and leadership lacks conversion clarity. RunMyCampus ties inquiry through enrollment to billing and class placement.
